suppress.notes: file name: mockserver-client-java-5.15.0.jar, mockserver-core-5.15.0.jar, mockserver-netty-5.15.0.jar This CVE applies to versions 5.13.0 and older and only when using velocity or javascript templates which interlok-service-tester-wiremock doesn't. Also the mock server is usually ran locally, automatically just a few second for service testing and is not used by users.
file name: swagger-parser-safe-url-resolver-2.1.16.jar This CVE applies to parse-url and not swagger-parser-safe-url-resolver
This vulnerability is inherited via com.jayway.jsonpath:json-path:2.9.0 however that is currently the most up-to-date version.
This vulnerability Apache Commons IO: from 2.0 before 2.14.0; interlok-core uses 2.19.0
org.mock-server:mockserver-netty:5.15.0 is the latest release published to Maven Central. Its transitive Prometheus simpleclient artifacts are also at the latest published 0.16.0 line.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.
